authority: Independent exploratory review; no user policy approved. Model counterexamples are not actual cloud mutations.

ranked_findings.finding: Saved destroy plan applies after HCL is changed to add prevent_destroy=true and a new retention-related input, removes its synthetic marker, and leaves empty state. New unapplied HCL/research retention does not invalidate OpenTofu state serial.
ranked_findings.correction: Bind actual apply admission to plan digest, configuration/root/membership revision, physical identities and live fence; disclose guarantees as cooperative only if independent deployment can bypass it.

ranked_findings.finding: Publishing a new adopted result depending on withdrawn compute before disposal succeeds, re-retains compute, and passes assert_safety although the result is unavailable.
ranked_findings.correction: Choose explicit withdrawal-versus-new-publication policy; distinguish operational dependencies from historical provenance and test each lifecycle boundary.

ranked_findings.finding: Manager.add overwrites an external identity as provisioned; GC deletes its synthetic file and invariants pass.
ranked_findings.correction: Reject duplicate canonical identities/ownership rebinding; use distinct replacement identities before treating invariants as admission-policy evidence.

ranked_findings.finding: Output A paired with state B across replacement has same lineage, serial 1 versus 2 and different IDs.
ranked_findings.correction: Extract manifest and lineage/serial from one snapshot or reject mismatched receipts; separately handle external drift.

ranked_findings.finding: Integration drops synthetic retention heads while history model head stays rooted. Disposal validates manually supplied resource exports, not full-history root extraction/completeness.
ranked_findings.correction: Validate root-export mapping before claiming end-to-end GC safety; current integration is real local glue with simulated retention/adoption.

ranked_findings.finding: Standalone adversarial entrypoint rmtree removes an existing fixed sandbox; retention tests overwrite fixed runtime fixtures. Fresh-only guarantee is provided by copied wrappers, not those standalone entrypoints.
ranked_findings.correction: Allocate new ignored run roots without pruning existing artifacts; preserve old synthetic evidence.

ranked_findings.finding: Deep copied lab paths exceeded Go provider Unix socket limit. Initial integration run failed; shorter owned layout now passes byte-identical scripts. Review separately reproduced failure and passed using a disclosed copy-local TMPDIR shortening.
ranked_findings.remaining: Standalone lab relocation remains path-sensitive; retain diagnosis and clean rerun evidence.
